summary: Took u18f's cheapest family. Two new generic capabilities: synthetic-default-import-interop (TS1259 -> tsconfig allowSyntheticDefaultImports, refusing esModuleInterop by counting 12 callable namespace imports; 13 refusals recorded) and promise-executor-void-parameter (TS2794 -> new Promise<void>, refusing any resolve that escapes or settles with a value). Production build 30 -> 27 diagnostics, still red, nothing introduced. Also measured ngx-electron 2.2.0 as View Engine only with ngcc gone, closing that NG6002 as a source demand rather than a capability. 33 new tests; tsc, lint, and the full 1770-test node suite green. Smaller itemized remainder recorded in u18g-capability-round.json.
